week.label: Tue 11-17 1pm → Tue 11-24 1pm
week.rule: Build up to 85% until Sunday's fantasy run, then use it up to 95% (until the Tue 1pm ET reset). Fantasy runs: Thu ~7pm and Sun 12:30pm ET, ~1-2 points each, always kept in reserve.

cost_note: Estimates come from your measured usage log. Each finished step records its real cost and clock times (started, ended, minutes), and estimates are adjusted. Sonnet steps have measured about 1 weekly point each, 20-45 minutes. 11-19 evening: a chat with 9 small items (7 PRs) cost ~3 weekly points and ~41 minutes, so small fill-ins run well under the older guesses.
